_readme: CSU Journal Finder — Agreement cap configuration. Edit this file and upload to GitHub to update cap warnings without touching index.html.

Wiley|Fully Open Access.label: Wiley Gold OA — cap nearly reached
Wiley|Fully Open Access.detail: The Wiley agreement has a shared cap on Gold (Fully OA) journals across all CAUL institutions. Publishing may no longer be funded if the cap has been reached. A 20% APC discount applies if you publish outside the cap. Check with the Library before submitting.

Springer|Fully Open Access.label: Springer Nature OA — uncapped
Springer|Fully Open Access.detail: The Springer Nature agreement is uncapped for 2026–2028. A forecast pool applies to certain Springer and Palgrave Open fully OA titles, but publishing does not cease if the pool's maximum threshold is reached.

_status_values.ok: No cap warning — agreement is uncapped or cap not yet reached
_status_values.capped: Cap warning active — show amber warning badge on journal cards
_status_values.reached: Cap reached — show red warning badge, publishing no longer funded

_how_to_update: To clear a warning, change 'status' from 'capped' to 'ok'. To mark cap as fully reached, change to 'reached'. Upload this file to your GitHub repo alongside index.html. Changes take effect within 2 minutes.
